shots.visual_event: Door One opens; brass name tags swarm the avenue and citizens momentarily exchange names with strangers.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “Don’t answer to a name that isn’t yours!”

shots.visual_event: Door Two opens; vertical rain floods upward through an underground market while Dev guides trapped children out.
Door Three opens; false childhood homes unfold across real storefronts, tempting people to enter impossible reunions.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera, over loudspeaker: “Ask the memory something only love would know.”

shots.visual_event: Doors Five through Eleven flash rapidly: stopped clocks, missing shadows, repeated streets, silent songs, and forgotten faces spill out as distinct physical events.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “These aren’t monsters. They’re unpaid lives.”

shots.visual_event: Arin punches each carriage coupling with the master tool, separating the doors from the engine without closing them on passengers.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin: “Open safely. Not all at once.”

shots.visual_event: Door Twelve remains sealed. From inside comes one heartbeat shared by hundreds of missing passengers.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias: “That is the debt Nila carried alone.”
